captured_plan_complete_buildable_ladder.rule: Captured source, exact tokens, source-lineage rows, audit findings, or ledger atoms are not plan-complete and are not buildable.
Plan-complete means canonical docs, PlanUnits, indexes, source lineage, and governance checks are coherent; it is not implementation buildability.
Buildability requires concrete schemas, command wiring, security boundaries, behavioral acceptance, currentness, persistence, provider behavior, and executable clean-room lifecycle evidence.

forbidden_scope: Approve And Build enablement for ordinary product work
pnc019_bootstrap_authority.partial_evidence_policy: Bootstrap authority records only partial/blocked evidence while IRB-005 runtime_lifecycle and IRB-011 clean_room_harness remain open.
pnc019_bootstrap_authority.closure_policy: Do not close runtime_lifecycle or clean_room_harness until executable lifecycle proof and clean-room fixture receipts exist.

non_executable_closure_policy.proof_semantics: Closed non-executable families prove owner-routed specs, schemas, validators, and negative/positive fixture contracts only. They do not prove runtime execution, rendered GUI dispatch, provider calls, activation, testing execution, or clean-room lifecycle behavior.
non_executable_closure_policy.buildability_rule: buildability_gate_passed remains false while runtime_lifecycle or clean_room_harness is open, while PNC-019 hard-disabled is present, or while executable_lifecycle_certification_complete is false.
